name: Tool Offer Agent
description: Kingan Logic's source-attributed API and MCP offer preparation agent. Reads public documentation, collects seller-stated terms, drafts and revises buyer offers, assesses readiness, and exports reviewed records. The MCP/REST preparation interface does not publish offers, execute purchases, certify sellers or authorize payments.

skills.name: Public documentation intake
skills.description: Read public API/MCP documentation and retain source-attributed evidence.

skills.name: Buyer offer preparation
skills.description: Collect seller terms and draft and revise a buyer-facing offer.

skills.name: Offer readiness assessment
skills.description: Evaluate retained offer readiness without granting approval or payment authority.

skills.name: Offer export
skills.description: Export structured and human-readable offer records with verifiable multipart retrieval.
